messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Word frequency
parts:
This may not be the most elegant way to do it, but it should give you an idea.

germcorp1<-scan(what="char", sep="\n", file="C://German source
file.txt") # reads in the file
positions<-(grep("^“",german)-1)
# gets the sentences, not the glosses
germcorp2<-unlist(strsplit(germcorp1[positions],"\\W"))
# splits them up into words, puts them into a vector
germcorp3<-germcorp2[which(germcorp2!="")]
# cleans out empty positions (punctuation)
sort(table(toupper(germcorp3)),decreasing=T)
# outputs a decreasing frequency list


--Martin
